name: tachyon-edge
description: Cloudflare Worker image service for the Tachyon WordPress plugin, built on the Cloudflare Images binding

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket with the WordPress Originals. Object Keys must match the path after the Worker host, e.g. `uploads/2026/11/photo.jpg`.

IMAGES.description: Cloudflare Images binding that resizes the images. Requires Images on the account; billed per unique transformation.

TACHYON_ORIGIN.description: `r2` reads Originals from `BUCKET`. `http` fetches them from `TACHYON_HTTP_ORIGIN`.

TACHYON_HTTP_ORIGIN.description: Only with `TACHYON_ORIGIN=http`: base URL of the Originals, e.g. `https://example.com/wp-content/`.

TACHYON_R2_BUCKET.description: Set automatically to the `BUCKET` name by `npm run deploy`. It keeps cached Variants apart per bucket.

TACHYON_KEY_PREFIX.description: Optional. Prepended to every Object Key before the Origin lookup.

TACHYON_PRIVATE_PREFIXES.description: Optional. Comma-separated key prefixes that require a presigned URL, e.g. `uploads/private/`. Leave empty if you have no private uploads.

TACHYON_SIGNING_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Only with private prefixes: the access key ID WordPress presigns private URLs with.

TACHYON_SIGNING_HOST.description: Only with private prefixes: host in the presigned URL, e.g. `<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`.

TACHYON_SIGNING_PATH_PREFIX.description: Only with private prefixes: path before the key in the presigned URL, e.g. `/bucket`. Empty for virtual-hosted URLs.

TACHYON_SIGNING_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Only with private prefixes: the secret access key WordPress presigns with. Without private prefixes, keep the placeholder.

author: Per Søderlind
